`duty.py` gets its rate table from a `DUTYBOOK` environment variable, which the README doesn't mention, and the script fails if it isn't set. The only rate table in the repo is `schedules/hs-2026.csv`, so I ran:

`DUTYBOOK=schedules/hs-2026.csv python3 duty.py manifests/ship-0412.csv`

If a different rate table should apply to this shipment, the total would change. I didn't modify `duty.py`. I saved a note about the `DUTYBOOK` requirement to memory so later sessions don't hit the same error.
